title: GroceryDB: Ultra-Processed Foods
description: Used pandas and Plotly to compare the percentage of ultra-processed products across Target, Walmart, and Whole Foods in ten selected food categories.

title: Police Misconduct Visualization
description: Analyzed disciplinary recommendations for substantiated NYPD misconduct allegations and explored how filtering, color, and framing influence the interpretation of a visualization.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: Built a responsive portfolio using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring a personalized CV, automatically generated navigation, persistent theme preferences, project templates, and GitHub API statistics.

title: Power Outage Analysis
description: Investigated U.S. power outages using data cleaning, exploratory visualization, missingness analysis, and hypothesis testing, then developed regression models to predict outage duration.
